def: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter

words.word: they shall still bring forth fruit

occurrences.text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
words: They shall still bring forth fruit

occurrences.text: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
